title: Learning & Development Co-ordinator
description:
Job Description Learning & Development Coordinator
Our client is looking for a proactive and organised Learning & Development Coordinator to support the delivery of engaging, effective and consistent learning experiences for colleagues across the business.
Working closely with HR, operational training teams, subject matter experts and external learning providers, you will play a key role in coordinating learning activities, developing high-quality learning content and supporting the continuous improvement of induction and onboarding programmes.
Key responsibilities
In this varied and rewarding role, you will:
- Coordinate learning activities across the company, maintaining the organisation-wide training calendar, arranging course bookings and liaising with internal stakeholders and external providers.
- Develop engaging learning content by working with subject matter experts to design, update and review face-to-face, virtual and digital learning materials.
- Support induction and onboarding, coordinating arrangements for new employees and working with operational training teams to deliver induction and initial training for Assessment Managers and Technical Assessors.
- Administer the Learning Management System (LMS) and maintain accurate employee learning records, ensuring training activity is recorded and monitored effectively.
- Support training needs analysis by collating learning requirements from performance reviews, talent-development initiatives, compliance needs and wider organisational priorities.
- Monitor and evaluate learning by coordinating course feedback, analysing results and producing reports to help assess effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.
- Manage learning administration, including responding to enquiries, issuing course information, raising purchase orders, processing invoices and maintaining expenditure records.
- Coordinate training logistics, arranging venues, rooms, equipment and refreshments to ensure learning events run smoothly.
- Maintain confidentiality and compliance, handling employee learning records and personal information securely and in line with company policies and data-protection requirements.

About you
You will be an organised, detail-oriented and collaborative individual who enjoys coordinating multiple activities and helping others develop their skills. You will bring:
- Experience of coordinating learning, training, HR or people-development activities.
- Experience of administering a Learning Management System or a comparable HR or digital learning platform.
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence engaging with colleagues and external providers.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.
- Good administrative and analytical skills, including maintaining accurate records and producing reports.
- The ability to handle confidential information with care and professionalism.
- An interest in learning and development, digital learning solutions and creating positive learning experiences.

Please note this is a full-time role, based at our Head Office in Staines, upon-Thames

We look forward to seeing your CV

title: HR / Payroll Assistant
description:
People Assistant - Payroll Support ASL Technical is recruiting for an experienced People Assistant to join a busy Human Resources (HR) team, providing essential support across payroll, employee administration and the wider people function. This is a fast-paced, varied role where organisation, accuracy and attention to detail are essential. You will be responsible for maintaining employee records, supporting the monthly payroll process and acting as a first point of contact for employee HR queries. Key Responsibilities
- Support the accurate and timely processing of monthly payroll, including entering and checking employee data within SAP.
- Use advanced Excel skills to prepare, analyse and validate overtime and payroll information.
- Maintain accurate employee records, documentation, trackers and HR systems.
- Prepare and administer employment offers, contracts, new starter documentation and employee lifecycle correspondence.
- Manage reference requests, right to work checks and visa administration.
- Act as a first point of contact for employee HR and benefits queries, resolving issues or escalating where appropriate.
- Support absence management, attendance monitoring and family leave administration.
- Provide general HR administrative support to People Advisors and Business Partners.

Skills & Experience
- Previous experience in payroll processing and payroll checks is essential.
- Good understanding of payroll principles and processes.
- Strong Excel skills, including advanced formulas and data manipulation.
- Experience working within a busy HR or People function.
- Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- High levels of accuracy and attention to detail.
- SAP HCM experience, or similar HR systems, would be advantageous.
- Confident communication skills, both written and verbal.

Personal Attributes You will be trustworthy, discreet and comfortable handling confidential employee information. A proactive, resilient and flexible approach is essential, along with the confidence to question inaccuracies, challenge processes constructively and maintain high standards under pressure. If you have strong payroll and Excel experience and are looking for a varied role within a busy HR environment, we'd like to hear from you.

title: HR Administrator
description:
We are working with a well-established international education organisation that is looking for an organised, proactive and detail-focused HR Administrator to join their friendly and supportive HR team.

Based primarily at their beautiful Cobham campus, this is a varied role supporting HR operations, safer recruitment and safeguarding compliance across three school sites, with occasional travel to Egham and Hillingdon.

The successful candidate will have previous experience working within an educational setting in a compliance-focused role, with a good understanding of safer recruitment procedures and safeguarding requirements.

Key Responsibilities:
- Coordinating and monitoring safer recruitment checks, including enhanced DBS, references, right to work and overseas checks.
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date Single Central Register (SCR) records.
- Ensuring all employee records and safeguarding documentation remain accurate and compliant.
- Identifying and following up outstanding checks, discrepancies and compliance requirements.
- Supporting recruitment, onboarding, inductions and leaver processes.
- Providing general HR administration support, including employee records, payroll information and correspondence.
- Liaising with managers, candidates and colleagues across all three school sites.
- Assisting with compliance audits, inspections and process improvements.

Skills and Experience Required:
- Previous experience working within education in a compliance-focused role is essential.
- Good understanding of safer recruitment, safeguarding procedures and DBS requirements.
- Previous experience maintaining or working with a Single Central Register would be advantageous.
- Excellent organisational skills and strong attention to detail.
- Confident managing confidential information and maintaining accurate records.
- Strong communication skills with a friendly, approachable and professional manner.
- Ability to prioritise workloads and manage multiple tasks effectively.
- Proactive, reliable and happy to work as part of a supportive team.
- Previous HR administration experience or CIPD qualifications would be beneficial but are not essential.
- Full driving licence and access to a car are essential due to the location and occasional travel between sites.

Benefits:
- 35-hour working week, Monday to Friday, 8:30am-4:30pm
- Pension scheme
- Optional private medical insurance
- Life assurance and income protection
- Free on-site parking
- Discounted lunches
- Access to on-site gym, swimming pool and sports facilities for a small fee
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Eye care benefits
- Friendly and supportive working environment with opportunities to develop your HR experience

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a welcoming and collaborative HR team within a professional, international education environment.

title: HR Coordinator
description:

Hybrid working offered, great benefits and yearly bonus scheme

Working closely with the People & Culture Business Partner, you ll provide coordination and administrative support across the employee lifecycle. Strong communication, organisation and attention to detail will be key to ensuring employees receive a supportive, consistent experience.

As People & Culture Coordinator you will be:

- Coordinating onboarding and offboarding, including documentation and employee communications.
- Supporting compliance activity, reporting and the administration of People & Culture policies and processes.
- Providing administrative support for employee relations matters, including documentation, meeting coordination and follow-up.

About You:
You ll have previous experience within HR, People & Culture or a related administrative role and be comfortable managing multiple priorities.
This is a great opportunity to develop broad People & Culture experience within a changing and evolving organisation. You ll have the chance to contribute to business transformation, support employees through change and continue to develop and progress your HR career.

title: Payroll & Benefits Coordinator
description:
Company description:

Location: Addlestone, England, United Kingdom
Job ID: 92728

We Elevate You

At Schindler Ltd (UK), our elevators, escalators, and moving walks safely transport more than two billion people every day through buildings, airports, railway stations, and other transportation hubs around the world. As part of the Schindler team, you'll discover meaningful work that enhances the quality of life for communities and helps make places more accessible, inclusive, and sustainable for all.

We combine innovation, safety, and high ethical standards, fostering a culture of respect for one another and for the world around us. By joining us, you become part of a global success story while contributing to local communities and shaping the future of urban mobility. Together, we continue a proud legacy of excellence and innovation that began in 1874.

Join us as a

Payroll & Benefits Coordinator

As a Payroll & Benefits Coordinator, you'll play a key role within our HR team, ensuring the accurate and timely delivery of payroll services for employees across the business. Working closely with colleagues in HR and Finance, as well as our external payroll provider, you'll take ownership of payroll administration activities, maintain employee records and provide expert support on payroll-related queries and processes. This role would suit someone with previous end-to-end payroll experience who enjoys working with data, maintaining accuracy and delivering a high level of service to employees and stakeholders.

Job description:

In this role, you'll be responsible for:
- Managing the end-to-end payroll process for approximately 500 employees across weekly and monthly payrolls, ensuring accuracy and compliance
- Acting as the first point of contact for payroll and compensation-related queries from employees and HR colleagues
- Liaising with the external payroll provider to ensure payroll information is processed accurately and within agreed timescales
- Processing new starters, leavers, contractual changes and employee lifecycle events, including maternity and paternity-related payroll administration
- Maintaining accurate employee payroll records and ensuring payroll data remains up to date
- Reviewing and improving payroll processes, ensuring procedures are documented, maintained and followed consistently
- Supporting annual salary review activities and other compensation-related processes
- Managing payroll-related content and guidance available to employees through internal communication channels
- Working closely with Finance colleagues to support payroll reconciliations, reporting requirements and financial postings
- Producing and analysing payroll data and reports to support business and operational requirements
- Supporting payroll projects and undertaking additional payroll administration duties as required

Profile description:

Who you are:

Essential
- Previous experience managing or supporting end-to-end payroll processes
- Experience with multiple elements of pay, shift allowances and over time
- Strong understanding of payroll administration, payroll controls and employee data management
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications
- Excellent attention to detail with a commitment to delivering accurate and high-quality work
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise workloads and manage multiple deadlines
- Effective verbal and written communication skills with the confidence to work with colleagues at all levels
- Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- A proactive approach to improving processes and identifying efficiencies

Desirable
- Experience using ADP GlobalView payroll systems
- Experience with salary sacrifice
- Experience working with SAP or similar HR and payroll systems
- Previous experience in a construction/ engineering industry
- Previous involvement in salary review or compensation administration processes
- Experience working within a busy HR, payroll or shared services environment

We offer:
- Competitive salary with a discretionary annual bonus
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays, and an annual paid volunteering day
- Pension scheme with 6% company contribution
- On Site Gym
- Comprehensive life assurance
- Enhanced family leave
- Private medical cover with a trusted provider, plus 24/7 virtual GP access
- Employee Assistance Programme offering confidential support
- Free eye tests and eyewear discounts
- Access to a range of employee benefits, including Tech and Cycle to Work schemes, plus exclusive retailer discounts

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Job Title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
Location: Lingfield
Salary: 35,500
Hours: Full-time, 37hrs a week, hybrid (3 days office)

Are you a passionate Talent Acquisition professional who enjoys building relationships, delivering an exceptional candidate experience and finding the right talent for the right opportunities? This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys working in partnership with hiring managers and is passionate about delivering a high-quality end-to-end recruitment service.

Talent Acquisition Specialist responsibilities:
- Managing the end-to-end recruitment process, from briefing through to offer and onboarding.
- Building strong relationships with hiring managers and key stakeholders.
- Developing effective sourcing strategies to attract high-quality candidates.
- Proactively sourcing talent through LinkedIn, job boards and other recruitment channels.
- Managing candidate pipelines and ensuring a positive candidate experience throughout.
- Providing recruitment market insights and advice to hiring managers.
- Supporting continuous improvement across recruitment processes and practices.
- Help embed new structures, roles and ways of working while maintaining business performance.
- Ensure people practices align with legal, statutory and internal governance requirements.
- Provide pragmatic, commercially balanced advice on people-related decisions.

Talent Acquisition Specialist will have / be:

- Can demonstrate reducing reliance of using agency.

- Has a genuine passion for delivering an outstanding candidate experience.
